title: Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong will introduce a bill by year-end to license crypto dealers, advisers, managers and custodians, after only two of 36 first-round stablecoin applicants received licenses in April. This post Hong Kong to License Crypto Dealers and Custodians by Year-End first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
